Given $△ABC$ shown above, which of the following diagrams represents the height corresponding to $\overset{―}{AC}?$
worked_solution:
The height (or altitude) corresponding to $\overset{―}{AC}$ is a line segment that 

- runs from the opposite vertex $B$ to the line $\overset{⟷}{AC},$ and

- is perpendicular to $\overset{⟷}{AC}.$

To draw the height, we proceed as follows:

- Extend the line segment $\overset{―}{AC}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945712/assets/5ebb72b8b79beefebac6ebd4a34cf229bc644d48a8de711eda1f2e20c31a67ec.png)

- Draw the perpendicular from $B$ to $\overset{⟷}{AC}.$
